title: omni x
description: Omni X - The Ultimate All-in-One Server Core
body:
# Omni X - The Ultimate All-in-One Server Core 🌟

Omni X is a completely free, highly optimized, and modular core plugin that replaces dozens of other plugins on your server (like EssentialsX, CMI, HolographicDisplays, OpenInv, AdvancedBan, etc.). Built specifically for modern servers, it operates entirely on SQLite, minimizing server load and ensuring smooth gameplay.

## 🚀 Key Features
- 💬 Real-Time Chat Translation (i18n): Stop forcing players to speak one language! Omni X automatically translates chat messages in real-time to the player's personal language preference (e.g. /lang en, /lang uk). All powered by a free Google API!
- 🛠️ Fully Modular Architecture: Don't need a feature? Disable it in config.yml! Only run what you actually need.
- 🛡️ Complete Moderation System: Bans, temp-bans, mutes, vanishes, social spy, and even a unique "cuffing" system (/cuff) to freeze suspected cheaters.
- 💰 Advanced Economy: Fast /sell feature based on a configured price list, and the ability to withdraw money into physical paper /cheques!
- 🎲 Smart RTP (Random Teleport): A fast, asynchronous RTP that actually checks for safe landing spots (no lava or deep ocean spawns!).
- 🎒 Virtual Menus & QoL: Open shulker boxes directly from your inventory (Shift + Right Click), use Undying Totems straight from your backpack, and access /wb, /anvil, and /grindstone on the go.
- 🌐 Localization Ready: All messages are fully translatable. Comes out of the box with English, Ukrainian, Polish, and German! (Supports HEX colors &#RRGGBB).
- 🪑 Roleplay Elements: /sit, /ride, and /lay anywhere in the world!
- ⚙️ Performance First
We believe your server TPS is sacred. Omni X performs all heavy tasks (like RTP calculations, database queries, and chat translations) asynchronously. It uses a single SQLite file, meaning no complex database setups, no lag spikes, and instant data retrieval.

## 📥 Installation
Drop OmniX-1.0.jar into your plugins folder.
Restart the server.
Edit config.yml and the lang/messages_xx.yml files to your liking.
Enjoy a seamless, lag-free experience!
